scope_note: This analysis does NOT download original media files. Estimates are derived from existing metadata records in data/staging/media/researched_media_candidates.json. No media files are bundled in Stage G1.

packaging_eligibility.rationale: RELATED_LOCATION records cannot be bundled as destination thumbnails — provenance is insufficient for in-app display without further verification.

thumbnail_package_estimate.note: Thumbnail actual byte sizes require image pipeline processing. Estimates based on industry standard WebP encoding at 80% quality.
thumbnail_package_estimate.recommendation: Thumbnails (57 KB est.) could be considered for OPTIONAL_OFFLINE_PACKAGE after WebP encoding and license clearance. Cards and heroes must remain CACHE_AFTER_USE. Heroes must remain NETWORK_REQUIRED for large destinations.
prerequisites_before_bundling: Image pipeline must transcode originals to WebP.
License for offline redistribution must be confirmed per MEDIA_LANGUAGE_VOICE.md.
Each image must pass visual authenticity review (no AI-generated tourist photos).
NO VERIFIED IMAGE = NO PUBLIC DESTINATION rule applies.

metadata_only_bundle.content: URL references, caption text, location identifiers, license strings only. No pixel data.

hard_invariants: No original media files downloaded in Stage G1.
No AI-generated tourist photos may be introduced at any stage.
RELATED_LOCATION images are not eligible for in-app display without further provenance verification.
WebP gate: all images must pass WebP encoding verification before mobile bundling.
